atoms.b: We had PE at school today. We got to play rounders, and it was very fun. ((--// ++ )) We played boys against girls, and the girls won by 12 points! ((--// ++ )) The boys were very annoyed. ((++// -- )) After lunch, we had a maths lesson, and it was so boring. ((--// ++)) Maths is my least favourite subject. ((--// ++ )) Luckily, it was home-time not long after. ((++// -- )) Once I got home, I  had to quickly get changed to go swimming. ((--// ++ )) My sister and I swam for 2 hours and were exhausted afterwards. ((--// ++ )) We fell asleep almost immediately.

atoms.text:
Almost all of Asia is located above the equator. It is surrounded by the Indian and Pacific Oceans. In terms of land mass, it’s the largest continent.

Asia is home to some of the most populated cities in the world: Tokyo, the capital of Japan; New Delhi, the capital of India; and Shanghai, a city in China. In total, Asia is home to 4.56 billion people, which is more than any of the other continents.

Within Asia, there are over 2,000 languages — many of which are thousands of years old. The most spoken language is Mandarin, which has around 1.1 billion speakers within Asia, followed by Hindi, which has around 600 million speakers.
